title: Skill Vector Index
description: ChromaDB collection for semantic skill retrieval. Each skill indexed with description embedding (nomic-embed-text via sentence-transformers, 384-dim, CPU), structured metadata (port types, technique, fitness, generation), and rendered thumbnail path. API: add_skill(), query_skills(task_description, top_k), deduplicate(description, threshold=0.92). Index persists at ~/.ix/voyage/skill_index/. Depends on VOYAGE-9.
definition-of-done: 1. ChromaDB collection created and persistent at ~/.ix/voyage/skill_index/. 2. add_skill() embeds description and upserts. 3. query_skills() retrieves top-K by cosine similarity. 4. deduplicate() checks for near-duplicates above threshold. 5. chromadb and sentence-transformers added to pyproject.toml.
testing-plan: 1. Add 5 skills with distinct descriptions. 2. Query 'organic horn shape' and verify tapered_horn ranks highest. 3. Verify deduplication rejects near-duplicate at 0.92 threshold. 4. Verify index persists across process restarts.
todos: Add chromadb and sentence-transformers to pyproject.toml
